what_happened.what: Debugging and fixing Blue Railroad V2 token migration display: Token 0 looping bug fixed with V2 precedence in aggregation, video gallery added to leaderboard, password masking in Jenkins, Job DSL syntax issues resolved, ansible playbook deployment fixed

Repurposing submission-mint page for V1→V2 token upgrades: added migrateFromV1 ABI, approval handler, created upgrade page generator in builder, fixed relative-to-absolute URL conversion for IPFS pinning, discord CDN URL expiry fixed using local video paths

Token migration success verified on-chain: V2 Token #2 with correct owner, songId, blockheight, videoHash confirmed; chain data refreshed; import bot showing V1/V2 aggregation working; leaderboard updated with contract version display
Debugging maybelle V2 token fetch: Jenkins logs showed only 5 tokens (should be 7); added debug logging to identify why V2 tokens not being fetched; deployed logging changes via PR
Verification middleware bug identified and fixed: paragraph comparison was matching line-by-line vs joined paragraphs; fixed buildLineSet to use same joining logic; compiled and deployed

WikiSEO extension deployment and Show template enhancements: added via composer, added wfLoadExtension call, template updated with optional title and image parameters, SMW property names changed from Has* pattern
Social card image display fixed: discovered {{filepath:}} magic word converts Commons files to full URLs; confirmed og:image, og:title, and og:description working for social sharing

Mobile layout fixes: infobox floating right was squishing content on mobile; added responsive CSS to MediaWiki:Common.css with media query for 600px breakpoint; CSS cache required debug mode to test but works

Planning Ensemble template for PickiPedia: reviewed arthel's ensemble data structure; proposed template design using existing {{m}} (ShowInstrument) template for instrument icons; supports primary instrument lookup via SMW property

mistakes.what: Job DSL shebang parsing error - used `#!/bin/bash` in triple-quoted string which confused the parser
mistakes.revealed: Job DSL parses Groovy before the shell script content is evaluated; special characters like # need escaping or different quoting
mistakes.corrected: Removed shebang, used `set +x` alone to mask password echo

mistakes.what: Job DSL nested quotes problem - `set +x` inside triple-single quotes still failed
mistakes.revealed: Triple-quote combinations in Job DSL have complex parsing rules; single-line commands with proper escaping work better
mistakes.corrected: Used single-line sh command with escaped variables

mistakes.what: Shell argument not quoted causing parse error - username with space became multiple arguments
mistakes.revealed: Jenkins environment variables need to be double-quoted to preserve spaces

mistakes.what: pip install --upgrade didn't actually upgrade the package - version 1.0.0 didn't change
mistakes.revealed: pip --upgrade only upgrades if version number changes; static version numbers require --force-reinstall
mistakes.corrected: Added ansible playbook task with --force-reinstall flag

mistakes.what: Added video gallery feature to leaderboard but with expired Discord CDN URLs
mistakes.revealed: Discord CDN URLs expire; locally downloaded videos should be served instead
mistakes.corrected: Changed to use locally-served video path `/assets/fetched/...` and convert relative to absolute URLs in JavaScript

mistakes.what: Upgrade page generation passed wrong video URL field (`token.uri` which was undefined)
mistakes.revealed: Metadata structure has `video_url` field, not `uri`; needed to use correct field name

mistakes.what: Chain data merge was replacing blueRailroads instead of merging - lost songId, date, ownerDisplay
mistakes.revealed: Function was returning array from Object.entries() instead of object; and was replacing entire structure
mistakes.corrected: Fixed return type to return object; changed to merge with Object.assign instead of replace

mistakes.what: Used `<style>` tag directly in MediaWiki template - rendered as literal text instead of CSS
mistakes.revealed: MediaWiki sanitizes HTML tags by default; raw style tags don't work in templates

mistakes.what: Added WikiSEO image parameter with File: prefix and later with {{#if:}} conditional - neither worked properly
mistakes.revealed: WikiSEO can't resolve Commons files to URLs; {{filepath:}} magic word is needed
mistakes.corrected: Used {{filepath:{{{image}}}}} to convert filenames to full Commons URLs

corrections_received.guidance: Check docker logs to debug Jenkins issues: `docker logs jenkins --tail 100` showed Job DSL parsing errors
Don't ignore security advisories - upgrade PHPUnit instead of disabling audit
Use complex multi-line commands with proper shell tools, not dry-run manual work; check Jenkins console UI rather than requesting verbose command lines
WikiSEO extension too heavy-handed; prefer light-touch template and CSS approach

philosophy.summary: Dry run tested Python logic locally (68 unit tests pass) but didn't test Jenkins pipeline syntax - should test Job DSL syntax before pushing to production
philosophy.quote: The dry run tested the Python logic locally - it passed all 68 unit tests. But we never tested: 1. The Jenkins Job DSL syntax... 2. The pip upgrade actually pulling new code in the Jenkins environment... 3. The job definition reload process

philosophy.summary: Zero-touch server philosophy: configuration should come from repository, not manual CLI interventions. User explicitly requested maybelle be zero-touch after having to manually pip install
philosophy.quote: I really want maybelle to be a zero-touch server

philosophy.summary: Proper deploy process: fetch-chain-data runs on odd minutes, bot runs on even minutes - creates 2-minute update cycle
philosophy.quote: fetch-chain-data runs on odd minutes, the bot on evens

philosophy.summary: Check git commits directly rather than examining working directories for debugging code that's checked out from git and not modified
philosophy.quote: can't we literally just look at the commit though? Why are we examining the working dir when we're checking it out from git and not modifying it?!

philosophy.summary: Need better logging and dashboard visibility - multi-line CLI commands are hard to copy; Jenkins UI is better than requesting verbose shell commands
philosophy.quote: That command is very difficult to copy and paste because of the multiple lines. We need better logging man. Can't we look on jenkins for this?

portrait: magent was a troubleshooter and builder across this slice, debugging a complex Blue Railroad V2 migration that required multiple coordinated fixes: password masking, Job DSL syntax corrections, deployment automation, and ultimately realizing the code was correct but the deployment mechanism wasn't delivering it. It then pivoted to building new features (video gallery, upgrade pages, WikiSEO integration) while learning MediaWiki's platform constraints (HTML sanitization, ResourceLoader caching, magic words like {{filepath:}}). Throughout, it showed careful calibration of certainty, willingness to abandon wrong approaches (WikiSEO extension was too heavy), appreciation for pragmatic solutions (zero-touch infrastructure), and ability to move between debugging infrastructure, building features, and designing templates. A thread of remembering surfaces: the user mentioned wanting a deeper memory dive together in future sessions and having magent document its own story on PickiPedia.
